P.name: Martial Poise
P.title: Template:Data Kalista/Martial Poise
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Martial Poise|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kalista |skill = I |icon = Martial Poise.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} During each {{tip|basic attack}} or casting of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', {{ci|Kalista}} can optionally choose a target direction to quickly {{tip|dash}} to. The range is based on dash angle and '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]] tier. The dash speed scales with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} and movement speed effects. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Innate - Oathsworn Bond:}} '''Kalista''' begins the game with an exclusive {{ii|Black Spear}}. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Kalista''' inputs a {{tt|movement command|Default MB2/right click}} during her {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}} or shortly after it completes, or while in cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', she will {{tip|dash}} in that direction.

'''''Kalista''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, and she will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.'' |description2 = ''Martial Poise'''s dash range and speed details: * Dash range of basic attacks is modified by the tier of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]] and the angle of the dash. ** At a 0° angle towards the target, the minimum dash range is {{pp|140;153;166;175|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units. ** At a 90° angle, the maximum dash range is {{pp|240;263;280;300|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units. * Dash range of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' is 300 units when dashing anywhere in the direction of the point of cast. ** If the dash is inputted to a location that is ''away'' from ''{{ais|Pierce|Kalista}}'' point of cast, the dash range is reduced based on the angle, with a minimum distance of 150 units if the inputted location is {{tt|directly opposite|Backwards dash}}. * Dash speed is increased based on the {{tt|tier|+75 for Boots and +135 for finished Boots}} of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]], and is affected by her {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} modifiers she is under the effect of (including {{tip|slow|slows}}). |icon3 = Black Spear item.png |description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Oathsworn Bond:}} '''Kalista''' begins the game with an exclusive ''{{ii|Black Spear}}'' that she can activate on an allied champion to deem them ''Oathsworn'', forming a {{tip|tether}} together. While she and the ally bound as the ''Oathsworn'' are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with ''{{ai|Sentinel 3|Kalista|Soul-Mark}}'' and ''{{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}}''. |description4 = '''''Kalista''' can purchase the {{ii|Black Spear}} from the [[shop]] at no cost to obtain it again and, before 3 minutes of game time, may activate the item again on a different target to designate a new Oathsworn. See {{ii|Black Spear}} for more details.'' |customlabel = Maximum Target Range |custominfo = {{pp|240;263;280;300|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} |customlabel2 = Dash Speed |custominfo2 = {{pp|1025;1100;1160|None;Basic;Finished|type=Boots Tier}} |tether radius= 1100 |targeting = Direction |affects = Self |damagetype = |grounded = True |knockdown = True |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |notes = * Basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' cannot be cast while dashing, unless animation cancelled with a movement command. * '''Kalista''' must wait for her auto attack windup or cast animation to finish, before she dashes. However, '''Kalista''' will dash immediately if the movement command to dash is input after her auto attack windup finishes. * {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} also "remembers" your auto attack target after dashing, letting you dash repeatedly by only clicking the ground. * {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} cannot keep up with attack speed values greater than {{fd|2.1}}, due to the combination of her auto attack windup taking too long, and her dashes being too slow. Movement speed bonuses make it less of an issue. ** Sufficiently high attack speeds can also cause {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} to interpret movement inputs as dash inputs, during the dash of a previous auto attack (such as jumping towards attack-move inputs). * Move commands inputted during an attack windup or the cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' while '''Kalista''' is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} will fail to cast and thus prevent the dash from triggering. * If multiple move commands are inputted during the attack windup, the most recent one is used for the dash's targeting. ** If the most recent input is not a move command, the dash will not trigger. *** In this case, the buffer for the previous move command was cancelled by a new non-move command such as an input for an attack or ability cast. ** The move command will still be buffered to the end of the immobilization or the end of the attack windup or cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' while grounded if it has not been overridden by other inputs. * '''Kalista's''' facing direction will change immediately on move command even among multiple inputs, but will not visually update until the dash. * The facing direction when dashing is considered to be in the direction of the dash, not her apparent facing direction based on her model's animation state. * Dash distance decreases as the dash direction becomes closer to the minimum direction. This defines a forward distance for basic attacks and a backwards distance for {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}.
Empirical testing has given the following values below. ** Basic attack dash range given the angle θ: *** \begin{cases}(175 + (125 \times \sin(\theta))) \times T \end{cases} **** Where T = 0.800, 0.875, 0.950, 1.000 depending on the tier of Boots (T0, T1, T2, T3) *** Minimum dash range of 225 units when dashing backwards ** ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista|Pierce's}}'' dash range given the angle θ: *** \begin{cases} 150 + (150 \times \sin(\theta)) & \mathrm{Backwards} \\ 300 & \mathrm{Otherwise} \end{cases} * There is a very brief grace period after completing a basic attack windup wherein '''Kalista''' can still input a movement command to trigger the dash. * The dash speed is unaffected by additive movement speed modifiers. * There are a total of 24 different dash ranges based on direction with {{ig|Boots}} and {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}} being cast. * '''Kalista''' will automatically be issued an attack command on her attack target at the end of the dash, as long as they remain in her attack range by then. * The attack move (default {{sbc|A + MB1}}) click feature checks for targets in brief intervals only if '''Kalista''' is not dashing. * {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for knocking the dash down.{{bug}} |flavorsound= {{sm2|Kalista_Original_BindAllyGlobal_0.ogg}} ''"The oath has been taken."'' }}

|champion     = Kalista
|skill        = W

If both ''Soul-Marks'' are applied to the same target, they take {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kalista''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Sentinel'' charge, up to a cap.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' summons a ''Sentinel'' that patrols back and forth on a path to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} along its trajectory as it travels.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive - Soul-Marked:}} While '''Kalista''' and her ''{{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}}'' are {{tip|tether|tethered}}, their basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a ''Soul-Mark'' to the target hit for 4 seconds.
|icon2        = Sentinel 3.png
|description2 = If both '''Kalista's''' and the ''Oathsworn's'' ''Soul-Mark'' are applied to the same enemy, the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target, capped against non-champions. ''Soul-Mark'' cannot affect an enemy more than once every few seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 18}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Maximum Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}}}}

|description3 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' summons a ''Sentinel'' that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings as it travels.
|description4 = '''Kalista''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Sentinel'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
|description5 = ''See [[Kalista#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Sentinels.''
|target range = {{tt|1400 - 5000|Minimum and maximum cast distance}}
|tether radius= {{tip|cr|1100|nolink=true}}

|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|cost         =

|spelleffects = proc

|spellshield  = 
|projectile   = 
|outofrange   = cast at max

* The damage is dealt {{tip|on-attack}} of '''Kalista's''' basic attack if she applies the second mark. If the ''Oathsworn'' does so instead, the damage is dealt [[on-hit]] of their basic attack.
* ''Soul-Marked's'' bonus damage is credited to '''Kalista''' and will benefit from both her {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic penetration}}}} and [[spell effects]].
** If her {{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}} ally scores a kill using ''Soul-Marked's'' bonus damage they will get a message stating 'Kill Secured' in place of the usual gold pop-up (the gold itself is credited to '''Kalista''').
* The ''Sentinel's'' {{tip|sight}} reveal on enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} is accredited for [[assist|assists]] and potentially [[kill|kills]] (if they die shortly after being spotted).
** It does not reveal {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} targets.
* ''Sentinel'' will cast from wherever '''Kalista''' is at the end of the cast time.
* {{Pending for test}} ''Soul Mark's'' interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}).
* {{pending for test}} If ''Pierce'' kills the target by ''Soul-Mark's'' additional damage, it will/will not continue.

E.wikitext:
{{#vardefine:b1a|5}}{{#vardefine:b5a|45}}{{#vardefine:b1b|7}}{{#vardefine:b5b|35}}{{#vardefine:ad|70}}{{#vardefine:ad1b|20}}{{#vardefine:ad5b|50}}{{#vardefine:ap|65}}{{#vardefine:aps|50}}{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Rend|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kalista |skill = E |icon = false |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Kalista}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' lodge a spear into their target, applying a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rend'' for a few seconds. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' rips out all lodged spears from nearby enemies, consuming all of their stacks to deal {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|slow}} to them for a short time. Each additional spear on the target deals reduced damage. |blurb3 = If ''Rend'' [[kill]]s at least one target, the cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reset}} and the {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}} is partially refunded. |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kalista's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rend'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 254 times per enemy. |icon2 = Rend.png |description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' rips out the lodged spears from all nearby enemies afflicted with ''Rend'' stacks, consuming the stacks on each target to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds. For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional {{as|physical damage}}. ''Rend'' deals 50% damage against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

''Rend's'' cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of '''Kalista's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' to apply ''Rend's'' effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them. |leveling2 = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1a}} to {{#var:b5a}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:ad}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:ap}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Bonus Damage per Additional Stack|{{ap|{{#var:b1b}} to {{#var:b5b}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1b}} to {{#var:ad5b}}}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:aps}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Slow|{{ap|10 to 42}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}} |description3 = If ''Rend'' kills at least one target, its {{sti|cooldown}} is reset and '''Kalista''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}. |description4 = ''A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability.'' |leveling3 = {{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|10 to 30}}|mana}}}} |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 1100 |cooldown = {{ap|10 to 8}} |cost = 30 |costtype = Mana |targeting = Proximity |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Physical |spellshield = True |spelleffects = Area of effect |parry = special |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * ''Rend'' cannot activate on {{tip|untargetable}} enemies. * ''Rend'' applies its effects instantly on cast. * ''Rend'' can be used during the dash of {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}}, and during the cast time of {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}. If ''Rend'' is used during the cast time of {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}, before the projectile spawns, doing so will repeat the first-spear damage to a target already damaged by ''Rend'', {{bug|2}} in addition to empowering the projectile with ''Rend's'' effects. * The cooldown will not reset if the target is protected by {{tip|resurrection}} effects. * If ''Rend'' is used against {{ci|Sion}} under the effects of {{ai|Glory in Death|Sion}}, the cooldown will reset even if it does not kill him.{{bug}} * A stack is not applied if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or missed while '''Kalista''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. * {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}} does not apply a stack of ''Rend'' if blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}. * While {{ai|Hostile Takeover|Renata Glasc|berserk}}, '''Kalista's''' attacks will also apply ''Rend'' stacks on allies. ** '''Kalista''' will be unable to cast ''Rend'' if there are no stacks on an enemy in range. *** ''Rend'' cannot cast on allies, even if a valid enemy target exists. As such, any spears on allied units are purely cosmetic. * ''Rend'' has a lower cast range than effect range. * ''Rend'' at maximum stacks will deal a total of {{as|{{ap|({{#var:b1a}} to {{#var:b5a}})+({{#var:b1b}} to {{#var:b5b}})*253}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad}}+({{#var:ad1b}} to {{#var:ad5b}})*253}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:ap}}+{{#var:aps}}*253}}% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}. }}

R.name: Fate's Call
R.title: Template:Data Kalista/Fate's Call
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Fate's Call|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kalista
|skill        = R
|icon         = Fate's Call.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kalista}} invokes her {{ii|The Black Spear|tether}} to retrieve her ''Oathsworn'', {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} them from all {{tip|crowd control}}, and hold them for a few seconds.
|blurb2       = While held, the ''Oathsworn'' may {{tip|dash}} to reappear at the target location. If they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}, they {{tip|airborne|knock up}} all nearby enemies.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' invokes her {{ii|The Black Spear|tether}} to retrieve and hold her ''Oathsworn'' for 4 seconds. '''Kalista''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the ''Oathsworn'' from all {{tip|crowd control}} and renders them {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for the duration, and {{tip|dash|pulls}} them to her over 1 second.
|description2 = While held, the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|vanish|vanished}} and may {{tt|select|Default MB1 / left-click}} a target location to {{tip|dash}} to with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, ending ''Fate's Call's'' invocation and reappearing at the location. If the invocation ends without the ''Oathsworn'' selecting a target location, they will automatically do so at maximum range from '''Kalista's''' facing direction.
|description3 = The ''Oathsworn's'' dash stops upon colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Upon the dash ending by collision or arriving to the targeted location, the ''Oathsworn'' {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies and keeps them {{tip|airborne}} for a set duration, while simultaneously {{tip|lunge|landing}} to their {{sti|attack range|'''base''' attack range}} {{tt|from the closest target hit|See notes}}.
|description4 = ''The Oathsworn must be within tether range to cast this ability, and is also {{tip|silence|silenced}} and unable to perform movement or attack commands while Fate's Call is in effect.''
|leveling3    = {{st|Airborne Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
|target range = 1200
|cooldown     = {{ap|160 to 120}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time = none
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Proximity
|affects      = {{ii|Black Spear|Oathsworn}} Ally / Enemies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = false
|projectile   = 
|notes        = 
* The ''Oathsworn's'' landing location of the lunge is precisely to their base attack range from the closest target they hit and relative to where this target would be displaced to from the knock back.
** In other words, the ''Oathsworn'' will land to a location where they are within their exact base attack range of the target by the end of the target's displacement.
** The calculated landing spot does not evaluate if the target was successfully displaced or not, meaning that the ''Oathsworn'' will end up closer than their base attack range if the closest target hit was not knocked back.
* The {{tip|airborne}} effect is attributed to ''Fate's Call's'' initial caster.
* If the ''Oathsworn'' does not hit any targets with the knock up effect, the dash will simply end and they will reappear at the target location.
* '''Kalista''' is briefly unable to start basic attacks or cast basic abilities when the ''Oathsworn'' starts their flight.
* The following will defer ''Fate's Call's'' effects at the time of cast to the end of their duration if the ''Oathsworn'' is:
** In a [[cast time]].
** {{tip|Channel|Channeling}}.
*** ''Fate's Call'' will not defer by the following channels: {{si|Recall}}, {{ai|Defiant Dance|Irelia}}, {{ai|Realm Warp|Ryze}}, and {{ai|The Culling|Lucian}}.
*** ''Fate's Call'' cannot be cast during the following channels: {{si|Teleport}}, {{ai|Gate|Twisted Fate}}, {{ai|Grand Starfall|Pantheon}}, {{ai|Hero's Entrance|Galio}} and {{ai|Stand United|Shen}}.
** Using an ability that preloads {{tip|unstoppableforcemarker|UnstoppableForceMarker}}.
*** If the ''Oathsworn'' is still occupied after 6 seconds of being deferred from this time, ''Fate's Call'' will cancel.
* ''Fate's Call'' will not pull the ''Oathsworn'' if they are {{tip|dash|dashing}} but they will be retrieved after 1 second regardless.
* ''Fate's Call'' can be cast even if the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Fate's Call'' is disabled if the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}} or is being affected by another ''Fate's Call''.
* ''Fate's Call'' can be used even if the ''Oathsworn'' is in a {{tip|zombie state}}.
* ''Fate's Call'' does not render the target {{tip|vanish|vanished}} while being held if they are creating {{ais|E|Senna}} aura.
* The ''Oathsworn'' being held is represented by a light over '''Kalista's''' head.
* '''Kalista's''' [[death]] does not cancel ''Fate's Call''.
|flavorsound= {{sm2|Kalista_Original_RAllyLowHealth_0.ogg}} ''"They shall not have you!"''
}}
